description:
Merge duplicate records of ANY table in Microsoft Dataverse / Dynamics 365 - also custom tables that the standard Dynamics merge (accounts, contacts, leads and cases only) does not support.

- Single merge: find the duplicate, see every related record (counters, chart, cascade rules), merge it into the master and deactivate the duplicate.
- Bulk merge from Excel: upload a sheet with Master and Slave columns, check every row, merge them all with live progress and per-row results.
- For accounts, contacts, leads and cases the Dynamics merge itself is used, so also e-mail recipients and closed activities move.
- Optionally fills empty fields of the master with the values of the duplicate.
- Every change is logged; merge history in the tool.

Support: send a message to Moly Omidvar on LinkedIn - https://www.linkedin.com/in/moly-omidvar/
Based on Related Records Analyzer by Jonas Rapp (GPL-3.0), modified and extended by Moly Omidvar.
releaseNotes:
3.2026.11.28 - fix
- Fixed "Cannot specify child attributes in the columnset for Retrieve" when filling empty fields of the master:
  lookup name fields and other helper fields (e.g. ...idname) are no longer read or copied
- Record analysis is protected against the same error when a quick find view contains such a field

3.2026.11.27 - first release of Molyom Merge
- Merge records of any table, also custom tables, one by one or in bulk from an Excel / CSV file
- Uses the Dynamics merge for accounts, contacts, leads and cases (activity parties and closed activities move too)
- Fills empty fields of the master from the duplicate (optional)
- Duplicates the master already has are skipped instead of failing; extra addresses are copied with a new number
- Optional deactivation of the duplicate; parental relationships are moved first, nothing is deleted
- Modern Fluent UI 9 interface: guided steps, counters, relationship chart, live progress, merge history
- CSV log of every change in Documents\Molyom Merge Logs
- No usage telemetry
summary: Merge duplicate records of any Dataverse table - one by one or in bulk from Excel - and see everything linked to a record before you merge.
title: Molyom Merge
